title: Towers of abelian groups with surjective transition maps are acyclic for the inverse limit
statement: Let $(B_n,g_n)_{n\geq1}$ be an inverse system [def-weil-inverse-system] of abelian groups whose transition maps $g_n:B_{n+1}\to B_n$ are all surjective. Then $R^q\varprojlim_nB_n=0$ for every $q\geq1$, where $R^q\varprojlim$ are the right derived functors [def-sp-left-exact-additive] of the inverse-limit functor on the abelian category of inverse systems of abelian groups [lem-pc-tower-abelian], which has enough injectives [lem-pc-tower-enough-injectives] and on which the inverse limit is additive and left exact [lem-pc-tower-limit-left-exact].

source.place: Tag 07KW, Lemma 15.88.1 (3) and its proof (ML systems, in particular systems with surjective transition maps, are right acyclic for lim; via Homology Lemma 0598 and Derived Categories Lemma 05TA)

proof.text: Fix a surjective tower $B=(B_n,g_n)$. By [lem-pc-tower-injective-embedding], embed it as a subobject $B\hookrightarrow I$ of a tower whose level groups are injective and whose transition maps $p_n:I_{n+1}\to I_n$ are split surjections. Put $Q_n=I_n/B_n$; the induced transition $Q_{n+1}\to Q_n$ is surjective, because a representative in $I_n$ lifts along the split surjection $p_n$ and its class maps to the prescribed class. Thus $0\to B\to I\to Q\to0$ is a short exact sequence of towers [lem-pc-tower-abelian].

The tower $I$ is injective in the tower category by [lem-pc-injective-split-tower-injective]. Therefore its higher derived limits vanish directly from the injective-resolution definition [def-sp-left-exact-additive]: resolve $I$ by the identity in degree zero. Since the kernel tower $B$ has surjective transitions, [lem-weil-pbc-tower-limit-exact-surjective-kernels] (b), with $R=\mathbf Z$, makes $\varprojlim I\to\varprojlim Q$ surjective. The long exact sequence of right derived functors for $0\to B\to I\to Q\to0$, supplied by [lem-weil-pbc-horseshoe-delta-functor] (2) (its hypotheses hold: the tower category has enough injectives [lem-pc-tower-enough-injectives] and $\varprojlim$ is additive and left exact [lem-pc-tower-limit-left-exact]), then has $\varprojlim I\to\varprojlim Q\to R^1\varprojlim B\to R^1\varprojlim I=0$; hence $R^1\varprojlim B=0$.

source.place: Tag 07KW, Lemma 15.88.1 (3), right acyclicity of Mittag--Leffler systems

proof.text: For every $q\ge2$, the same long exact sequence gives an isomorphism $R^q\varprojlim B\cong R^{q-1}\varprojlim Q$, because the adjacent groups $R^q\varprojlim I$ and $R^{q-1}\varprojlim I$ vanish. The quotient tower $Q$ is again surjective by Step 1, so induction on $q$ (with the base case $q=1$ proved in Step 2, applied to every surjective tower) gives $R^{q-1}\varprojlim Q=0$, and therefore $R^q\varprojlim B=0$.
